clips.title: The story
paras: In Dustwallow Marsh, Deadmire stalks the murky waters, and his tooth marks an honorable hunt. Melor Stonehoof on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff receives it as proof that the ancient crocolisk's suffering has ended.

Tauren hunters on Hunter Rise see the hunt as a bond of balance, reverence, and mercy. Deadmire was once among the most magnificent crocolisks in Dustwallow Marsh. Great age turned his final years to torment, though he kept the fierce spirit of his prime. His massive bones and failing body had become a prison of pain. Deadmire's Tooth gives Melor Stonehoof proof that an honorable hunt has ended the beast's suffering.
